AINE Evolution Pathway: Atom → Sanctuary

Stage 1: AINE (Atom)

Individual entropy bot

Single-purpose AI agent focused on one entropy dimension (e.g., insurance pricing intelligence)

Financial
$5K-50K founder investment
Trigger to Coalition
Proof of 5+ paying customers

Stage 2: Coalition (Molecule)

2-4 complementary AINEs

Multiple AINEs combine to create compound intelligence (e.g., Insurance + Risk + Actuarial)

Financial
$50K-250K seed round
Trigger to Vertical
$25K MRR achieved

Stage 3: Vertical Stack (Organ)

Full domain platform

Complete stack for vertical (InsurTech, FinTech, etc.) with UI, API, compliance, customer success

Financial
$500K-2M Series A
Trigger to Entity
$250K MRR from vertical

Stage 4: Entity (Organism)

Autonomous business unit

Fully independent company with own P&L, leadership, go-to-market, and governance

Financial
$2M-10M Series B+
Trigger to Alliance
Related vertical acquisition or partnership

Stage 5: Alliance (Species)

Cross-domain coordination

2-4 entities coordinate (Insurance + FinTech + Real Estate) for higher-order capability

Financial
$10M-100M cross-entity revenue
Trigger to Platform
5+ verticals aligned on commons

Stage 6: Platform (Ecosystem)

Horizontal infrastructure layer

Shared infrastructure serving 5+ verticals with common marketplace, governance, AI orchestration

Financial
$100M-1B ecosystem revenue
Trigger to Sanctuary
Government adoption + regulatory integration

Stage 7: Network (Sanctuary)

Institutional infrastructure

Becomes invisible utility layer embedded in government, academia, and international standards bodies

Financial
Global public infrastructure
Endpoint
Ecosystem inevitability

Worked Example: Insurance Evolution

NAICS 524210: Insurance Agency & Brokerage
Evolution Path:
1. AINE: InsurancePricingBot (market data + underwriting rules)
2. Coalition: InsuranceBot + RiskBot + ActuarialBot (claims prediction)
3. Vertical: Full InsurTech Platform (UI, API, compliance, partner integrations)
4. Organism: Insurance Intelligence Entity (independent company, $5M ARR)
5. Species: Insurance + Property + Liability + Healthcare Alliance
6. Ecosystem: FinTech Platform (Insurance + Banking + Investment)
7. Sanctuary: Global Insurance Intelligence Network (regulatory embedded)
